findings.title: Live third-party API key hardcoded in client-side bundle
XSS: user-authored review body and third-party translation rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML
Fetch response status never checked; HTTP errors parsed as data
Floating promise: load() rejection is unhandled, loading spinner never clears and no error state is shown
useEffect dependency array missing productId; reviews go stale when the prop changes
Effect has no cleanup/AbortController; race condition and state updates after unmount or prop change
N+1 sequential author fetches inside a loop (request waterfall, duplicate authors refetched)
Unvalidated API response cast with 'as'; bad data (e.g. negative rating breaks '★'.repeat) not caught
Path segments interpolated into URLs without encodeURIComponent
Clickable div instead of button: not focusable or keyboard operable, no role
Translation cache keyed only by review id; stale translation shown after targetLanguage changes
Translation failure replaces the original review body with an error string instead of a separate error state
Leftover console.log dumping loaded review data
aria-label on a generic span (no role) is prohibited by ARIA 1.2 and not reliably announced
